scope: Gate-neighborhood budget shadow; no control or period changes; not a safety certificate
assumptions: Gate geometry and clearance are inherited from the flight harness, not a newly calibrated airframe envelope.
The 0.25m clearance is an effective body-radius-plus-margin assumption, not a measured drone width.
Both 3m/s error-rate bounds must hold until the next command arrives; sampled checks cannot prove this.
R_next is estimated by max(30ms, maximum of the last 32 already dispatched responses plus 5ms); this is not WCET.
The first-slide lateral formula is extended separately to the vertical opening; forward speed is not the error-rate bound.
Only a +/-2m longitudinal gate neighborhood is monitored; no constraint is claimed for the rest of the route.
Host sample-request and async command-dispatch timestamps approximate sampling and actuation; sensor age and actual actuator acknowledgement are unavailable.
